title: Monthly Report
overallCumulativeNote: * Overall Cumulative = Annual Cumulative + prior years' actuals. It looks the same as Annual Cumulative until you enter "Prior-Year Cumulative" in the Data Entry tab.
statusRuleProgressGreen: Overall cumulative actual ≥ overall cumulative plan
statusRuleProgressYellow: Overall cumulative actual ≥ overall cumulative plan, but this month's actual < this month's plan
statusRuleProgressRed: Overall cumulative actual < overall cumulative plan
statusRuleRevenueGreen: Annual cumulative actual ≥ annual cumulative plan
statusRuleRevenueYellow: Annual cumulative actual ≥ annual cumulative plan, but this month's actual < this month's plan
statusRuleRevenueRed: Annual cumulative actual < annual cumulative plan
statusRuleCostYellow: 3 or more items deviate 2%–5% from plan
fundsSyncNote: * Same as the Management Dashboard's cash flow (including the detail view)
fundsDetailNote: * The detail view table adds revenue, confirmed amount, and collection receivable
